title: Get 1TB of cloud storage for life with one $200 payment
content_html:
TL;DR: Pay $199.99 once for lifetime access to 1TB of Koofr cloud storage, with encrypted files, multi-device access, and tools for managing your digital clutter.

Credit: Koofr

$199.99
$810 Save $610.01

Cloud storage is useful. Adding another recurring payment to your monthly expenses? Annoying. Koofr Cloud Storage is just $199.99 (reg. $810) for a lifetime 1TB subscription, giving you plenty of space without an ongoing storage bill.

That 1TB can hold the digital stuff that tends to multiply over time, whether you’re keeping work documents, multimedia, software, or other important files. And because Koofr works across smartphones and computers and supports WebDAV, your files aren’t stuck on one device.

Koofr can also connect with existing Dropbox, Google Drive, Amazon, and OneDrive accounts. That makes it useful for anyone whose files have gradually scattered across multiple cloud services. Instead of remembering where you put something six months ago, you can access your connected storage from one place.

There are some handy organizational features, too. Koofr’s Duplicate Finder can help identify unnecessary copies eating into your storage, while advanced renaming options provide additional control over your files.

Privacy hasn’t been treated as an afterthought. Koofr doesn’t track you, and files are encrypted both while they’re stored and during transfer.

Rather than paying repeatedly for cloud storage, one payment gets you lifetime access to 1TB. For someone who already knows they’ll continue needing cloud space, paying once can be a much cleaner approach.
